And just to clarify, YES, we can absolutely be happy & excited about the good things that Pres. Oaks said in this talk while discussing what is problematic. That is valid.

#BlackLivesMatter 

Amen. :)

"We can't blame it on him. He's a manifestation of the ugliness that's in us."

A reckoning is coming. Nay, the reckoning is here at our doorstep. Which side of that reckoning do you want to be on? Which side do you want your kids & your grandkids to see you on?

#BLM #Racism

^^this is why I reject the "ACAB" mantra (but don't condemn anyone who feels that way), and also support #BLM and the concept behind defunding the police. We NEED reform NOW. But that also doesn't mean I am going to participate in the demonization of a group.

Your history doesn't need to define you, but you still need to reckon with your past honestly, otherwise, it will hold you back. That is as true for individuals as it is for nations.

I'm grateful that in 2020, I began to really open my eyes to history. #BlackLivesMatter

Pretty rich to see the same conservatives blasting #BLM protesters this summer are now participating in &/or encouraging civil disobedience in a way which threatens public health. https://t.co/Z4RCpHlUjm
